selectionPolicy.reviewedRows: Human-reviewed allow-list in scripts/vocabulary-curation.ts; source identity and expected word are emitted into this manifest.
selectionPolicy.gradePolicy: Grade is explicitly assigned by the named curation group; it is not inferred from id, length, alphabetic order, topic, or frequency.
selectionPolicy.mediaPolicy: A missing image is WARN and may activate, but remains ineligible for IMAGE_TO_WORD; usable audio is required and known unusable/corrupt media blocks activation.
selectionPolicy.activationPolicy: Only manifest rows are enabled; existing starter rows, learner assignments, progress, reviews, XP, and achievements are preserved.
